name: astral-onslaught-duration|Astral Onslaught extends Astral Blade's duration by 7 sec (#1359)
contract: Astral Onslaught 704789 (Spell.dbc, SpellFamilyName 32, passive 0x1c0) carries SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) with EffectMiscValue SPELLMOD_DURATION (1), EffectSpellClassMask word2 0x200000 and EffectBasePoints 6999, resolving to 7000 with DieSides 1, matching 'Increases the duration of Astral Blade by $/1000;s1 sec'. Astral Blade 805563 has SpellFamilyFlags word2 0x200000 and DurationIndex 28, which SpellDuration.dbc gives as 5000 ms, and no SPELL_ATTR3_IGNORE_CASTER_MODIFIERS (and that attribute would still allow SPELLMOD_DURATION, SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod). Native path only: Aura::CalcMaxDuration applies SPELLMOD_DURATION through Player::ApplySpellMod; the module's OnCalcMaxDuration hook only clamps other spells. The spell_modifier metric runs that same ApplySpellMod on the shipped duration: 5000 + 7000 = 12000. Sentinel Glaive 800506 (word2 0x20000000, DurationIndex 31 = 8000 ms) carries a different class mask and must keep 8000. Both fixtures are the same race, class and level. A real cast is not used: the probe reads the modifier exactly as Aura::CalcMaxDuration would consume it and needs no hostile target or hit roll.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
